title: I wondered what it would take to earn $1M in one month from one song on Spotify. It's roughly the population of Belgium pressing play daily for a month.
dek: A back-of-the-envelope tour through Spotify's pro-rata pool, from looping a song for a month to taking home the money.

title: I wondered if cars were rear-ending SUVs more often. The data says no.
dek: I drove a Honda Accord for years and felt taller vehicles in front of me made everything harder to see. I went looking for the data to see if my felt experience matched the crash record.

title: Building the portfolio I'd actually want a recruiter to read.
dek: The brief, the rejected directions, the design decisions I made on the way to a v1 - and the one thing I'd tell another analyst to do before designing anything.
